agencyRequests: MTCC/RTL: full bus and ferry service calendars, directions, stop times, validity and exceptions; aggregate boardings and vehicle loads by stop/time.
HDC/council: audited facility entrances, step-free boarding paths, crossings, pavement continuity, completion dates and occupied housing units.
Health and Education ministries: suitable services, grades, public/private admissions, current operating hours, staffing and capacity by facility.
MTCC/STO/STELCO: local vehicle, labor, energy, maintenance and route-specific operating costs; observed arrival-time reliability.
MBS/Elections Commission: official boundaries matching Census constituency indicators and clear cohort/nationality definitions.
